_meta.source: ACAPS Risk Radar export (data/risk-radar-export.csv), used under ACAPS terms of use
_meta.note: Real risk IDs, titles, ratings and outcome text. similarity is a placeholder. Ranked formula (same as scripts/export_api_files.py): p_materialise = share of resolved risks with the same ACAPS probability rating that happened; uncertainty = round2(4*p*(1-p)); impact = Impact/5; priority_score = round2(0.5*uncertainty + 0.5*impact).

R1043.title: Camps and basic services in East Darfur state are stretched beyond capacity following the influx of up to 100,000 South Sudanese refugees by June 2016
R1043.what_happened: The refugee population in East Darfur state had dramatically increased by 2016, with numbers rising from 164 individuals in December 2015 to over 47,000 by June.

R1043.title: Intensifying humanitarian and security crisis in Kenya worsens conditions in refugee camps
R1043.what_happened: Kenya’s humanitarian and security situation deteriorates, particularly in refugee-hosting areas such as Garissa and Turkana counties.

R1043.title: A prolonged Syria–Lebanon border conflict results in displacement and increases shelter and livelihood needs
R1043.what_happened: The risk improved slightly in April 2026 after tensions rose in March with an escalation between Hezbollah and Israel.
